items.title: The conormal sequence of two formally unramified morphisms with a formally smooth composite is short exact
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma sharpens the conormal sequence of a pair of formally unramified morphisms: when the composite is additionally formally smooth, the sequence is short exact rather than merely right exact. The proof constructs the relevant universal first order thickenings, compares the two thickenings through the formally smooth hypothesis, and shows that the connecting map vanishes, which upgrades right exactness to exactness in the middle. The comparison of the two universal thickenings and the identification of the vanishing condition is the substantive step. Retained author proof at lines 5036-5080 with the surrounding argument.
